description: This file implements SSH sandbox backend management, including runtime description, creation, and session handling, for a sandbox environment in a software project.

classes.name: SshSandboxBackendImpl
classes.description: Class managing SSH sandbox backend sessions, ensuring runtime setup, directory replacement, and command execution.

methods.name: describeRuntime
methods.description: Checks if the SSH sandbox runtime is active and matches the expected configuration.

methods.name: removeRuntime
methods.description: Removes the SSH sandbox runtime environment.

methods.name: createSshSandboxBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new SSH sandbox backend handle.

methods.name: asHandle
methods.description: Returns a handle object representing the SSH sandbox environment with methods for command execution and session management.

methods.name: runRemoteShellScript
methods.description: Executes a remote shell script within the SSH sandbox environment.
